title: Admission Ticket: Explore Canada in Miniature Scale
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
A journey of discovery through a vast, highly detailed and animated miniature attraction. From captivating vistas to famous Canadian landmarks like the CN Tower, Niagara Falls, and the Bay of Fundy, explore and celebrate Canada under one roof, in the heart of downtown Toronto.

It is the only attraction in the world that represents Canada in miniature, complete with moving vehicles, thousands of miniature people and hundreds of miniature sights of interest. 

Open Sunday to Wednesday: 10am - 6pm 
Open Thursday to Saturday: 10am - 9pm
Including statutory holidays. Closed Christmas Day.

Last entry is 90 minutes before closing time.

The 'Little Me' experience is not included with this ticket. To purchase a Little Me please see Littlization team onsite.

Accessible entrance: 10 Dundas St E
